status: Accepted for the stated desktop figure-layout and caption-legibility scope only.

scope.review: Actual documentary-reference figure UI, four atlases and 24subjects. Layout, crop isolation, caption legibility and explicit prototype/documentary limits only.

steps: Open the six people, six opponents, six equipment and six fleet screenshots individually at original detail.
Compare each visible subject and legend to its nominal metadata identity and exact declared source region.
Inspect corners, silhouette/head/weapon endpoints, adjacent fragments, dark-panel blending and caption overlap.
Verify documentary-only NPC/fleet legends and explicit family-concept mod descriptions.
Hash all 24screenshots and record their dimensions for comparison with the completed frozen browser run.

sourceArtReview.scope: Prior bounded source-atlas layout/recognition review. Three official figure comparisons support only broad Mako, SR-1 and Vindicator identity; no global primary-model verification.

summaryObservations: All 24figures display one intended subject inside the declared region, without a visible neighboring cell.
Corrected custom equipment regions preserve Vindicator endpoints and Terminus helmet/feet.
Bust heads, enemy silhouettes, armor figures, weapons and vehicles/ships remain readable on the dark panel.
All 24captions visibly state prototype, fixed image and original model not certified.
Aria ME2 and Traynor ME3 captions explicitly remain documentary and grant no recruitment.
Barrel and magazine captions explicitly describe original family schematics, without an official named model.
Vehicle and ship captions explicitly limit the illustrations and do not promise driving, upgrades, rebuilt interiors or a 3D kit.
Praetorian, Kai Leng and Banshee captions retain relevant incomplete-mechanics warnings.

previousSourceFinding.status: Resolved in source metadata and visibly clean in actual UI.

supportingVisualCheck.name: Twenty-four exact work-scoped generated illustrations really decode and render through documentary UI with bounded clipped cells; NPC and fleet overlays grant no combat or gameplay permission

functionalEvidence.scopeDistinction: The completed browser run additionally checks decoding, served PNG hashes, exact rectangles, nested clipping, foreign-context/helper refusals and campaign isolation. This independent visual report accepts the actual 24documentary panel screenshots only; it does not extend that to original-model fidelity or unreviewed battle/mobile layouts.

limitations: Desktop 1440×1000 documentary figure panels only. No mobile, tablet, full-screen scrolling, loadout thumbnail or battlefield illustration layout certified by these 24captures.
No new primary character/model sources were consulted in this UI review. All 24entries retain primaryVisualVerified:false and partial:true.
Readable broad silhouettes and metadata identities do not certify named facial likeness, exact suit, anatomy, texture, palette, mesh, material, weapon geometry or 1:1 fidelity.
A fixed generated illustration does not complete any animation, eight-direction movement, original boss phase or equipment-dependent costume task.
No driving, flight, upgrade acquisition, ship interior, squad recruitment or new 3D geometry is delivered by a documentary image.
The screenshots do not themselves prove every absent context, storage isolation or combat restriction; those claims require the final functional runner evidence.
Captions are legible in the reviewed native desktop captures, but no accessibility, color-vision, screen-reader or zoom conformance audit was performed.
